scripts.prepare:app: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path 'app') { Remove-Item -Path 'app' -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'app','app/css','app/js' -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path 'index.html','zebrus.png' -Destination 'app' -Force; Copy-Item -Path 'css/new-ui' -Destination 'app/css' -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path 'js/new-ui' -Destination 'app/js' -Recurse -Force"
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:app && npx http-server app -p 1420 -c-1
